item.title: International Brand Communications Marketing Manager, Holistic Health
item.description: International Brand Communications Marketing Manager, Holistic Health Organization: Nestlé Health Science Location: Bridgewater, NJ Date Posted: 07/20/2026 About Nestlé Health Science At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature’s Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases. At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers. — International Brand Communications Manager The International Brand Communications Manager drives demand generation and brand growth across international OUS/CA markets by translating global brand strategies into impactful, locally relevant campaigns. The role ensures consistent execution of global “Big Ideas”, while tailoring them to local market realities, and supports distributor partners in delivering high-quality marketing plans and execution. As the Manager, you will connect global strategy with in-market activation, ensuring strong brand consistency and commercial impact across markets. — Responsibilities Brand Strategy & Campaign Execution Translate global/US brand strategies into actionable campaign plans for international markets. Partner with US teams on Big Ideas and campaigns, driving deployment across international markets while ensuring consistency and local relevance. Define and guide go-to-market and channel strategies in partnership with Distribution Managers. Ensure high-quality execution standards across markets. Conduct fact-based assessments to support geographical expansion and define how to win in international markets. Collaborate with Innovation (I&R) and Portfolio teams to ensure strong pipeline alignment for international markets. Distributor & Market Support Support distributor partners during brand launches, guiding development of local marketing plans. Strengthen existing distributor strategies to align with global initiatives in conjunction with distributor managers. Ensure execution excellence by reviewing campaign deployment, gathering feedback, and driving improvements. Ensure alignment with global brand strategy across all markets. Deliver international business goals in close collaboration with distributor partners, managers, and cross-functional teams. Performance Tracking & Optimization Track and monitor brand performance across international markets. Translate data and market feedback into actionable improvements. Identify growth opportunities through fact-based performance analysis. Partner with Finance to track KPIs and ensure robust performance reporting. Budget allocation and tracking. Project Management Coordinate campaign timelines across markets. Ensure alignment across stakeholders and deliverables. — Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Development, or a related field. MBA is preferred but not required. Strong business analytics skills. 5+ years of proven marketing leadership with a focus in marketing on FMCG/VMS brands, healthcare brands. Sales and category management experience is an important plus. Ability to navigate and collaborate in an international business environment with countries and partners. In-market experience with holistic brand building, focusing on ATL, BTL and digital marketing. Retail marketing experience. Good understanding and experience in digital marketing, social media marketing, and eCommerce. Strong project management skills, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously. Broad stakeholder management experience, including working with third-party agencies and vendors. Experience bringing new brands into new markets. Excellent communication skills, creativity, organization, and the ability to influence without authority. Proficiency in English. Preferred Skills Experience working in distributor-led and highly fragmented international markets. Ability to identify and scale best practices across markets. Strong understanding of how to balance global consistency with local market adaptation. Experience translating campaign performance into scalable improvements across multiple markets. Exposure to complex multi-brand portfolios and cross-market activation models. — Compensation & Benefits The approximate pay range for this position is $120,000 to $130,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at About Us | Nestlé Careers (nestlejobs.com) #LI-MR1 — Inclusion Commitment It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace. To our veterans and separated service members, you’re at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you’ve gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home. The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. item.title: Global Innovation Brand Manager, Holistic Health
item.description: Global Innovation Brand Manager, Holistic Health Organization: Nestlé Health Science Location: Bridgewater, NJ Date Posted: 07/20/2026 At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature’s Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases. At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers. ## International Brand Manager (ABM), Holistic Health Innovation The International Brand Manager (ABM), Holistic Health Innovation, supports the development and execution of innovation and renovation initiatives across the Holistic Health (HH) portfolio (Nature’s Bounty, Osteo Bi-Flex, Nuun, GARD and Puritans Pride Outside US/CA). This role is responsible for driving data-informed decision making, inputting in product renovations, and partnering cross-functionally and externally with distribution partners to execute innovation projects from concept through launch and supporting on post-launch optimization. The ABM drives insight-led growth across the HH portfolio by translating market trends and performance into clear innovation priorities. The role is accountable for defining where to play and how to win in international markets, identifying white spaces, and shaping portfolio strategies for both new launches and existing businesses. ## Key Responsibilities ### Business analytics & performance – Own ongoing performance tracking across innovation and renovation platforms (consumption, velocity), highlighting distributor performance – Deep collaboration with distribution partners to build business plans for innovation – Develop a deep knowledge of actionable insights in key markets to inform pipeline prioritization and renovation decisions – Look for efficiencies across markets on innovations to serve as many geographies as possible – Monitor competitive landscape, innovation pipelines & performance, and category shifts in key markets – Support post-launch tracking and optimization recommendations – Build executive-ready reports and dashboards for leadership updates ### Renovation & innovation execution – Lead renovation initiatives (formula, claims, packaging updates, flavor extensions) leveraging US work to extend across brands for international markets – Drive execution of innovation projects through stage-gate process (brief development → launch readiness) built upon US base where possible and stand-alone where cases are robust enough – Partner with US brand, insights, digital, R&D, medical, regulatory, packaging, and operations on product development decisions – Support concept development, claims & concept validation, and consumer research to ensure the international perspective is represented – Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with brand strategy ### Marketing & commercialization support – Support development and execution of innovation marketing plans and launch strategies OUS coordinated with global MKT and distribution partners – Support presentations and commercialization assets – Partner with US sales/customer development teams on launch planning and customer-specific needs – Ensure alignment between innovation pipeline and integrated commercial planning (ICP) for OUS markets ### Project management – Track and manage innovation/renovation project timelines ## Requirements – 5+ years of brand management for a CPG Food, CPG Personal Product or OTC brand; international experience – **Functional Skills:** strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate market dynamics into actionable tactics – Hands-on experience working with market, consumer, and distributor data, with the ability to translate insights into clear “where to play / how to win” decisions and identify international white space opportunities – **Strategic Skills:** collaborative/team player, strategic agility, proven ability to make complex decisions, dealing with ambiguity, ability to influence senior management on strategic decisions based on actionable insights, ability to operate in a multi-cultural, international environment with diverse partners – Strong proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word – Ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment – **Energy & Drive:** self-starter, independent thinker, action oriented, strong passion for results – **Organizational Positioning Skills:** strong presentation skills & written communications, ability to interact successfully with senior management – **Personal & Interpersonal Skills:** customer & consumer focus, skilled at building and fostering effective peer relationships, proven ability to effectively collaborate across functional areas – Multi-lingual preferred but not required ## Preferred Skills – Marketing budget management – Volume forecasting – Project management The approximate pay range for this position is $135,000 to $145,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. To our veterans and separated service members, you’re at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you’ve gained while serving our country—such as flexibility, agility, and leadership—are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home. The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. item.title: Director, Global Strategic Marketing
item.description: Director, Global Strategic Marketing Organization: Repligen Corp. Location: Remote Date Posted: 07/20/2026 ## Make a global impact—join Repligen We’re united by a mission to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a preferred partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. No matter your role or background, at Repligen, you will play a key part in shaping some of the most innovative and life‑changing therapies in the world. We foster a culture of purpose, collaboration, and shared success—where every voice matters and every contribution drives progress. Join us! ## Director, Strategic Marketing – Chromatography Repligen is seeking a Director of Strategic Marketing to lead global marketing strategy for the Chromatography business unit, including resins and pre‑packed columns. This role is responsible for translating business strategy into high‑impact, demand‑generating marketing programs that drive customer preference, accelerate adoption, and deliver measurable revenue growth. As a strategic leader and player‑coach, this individual will operate at the intersection of commercial, product, and technical teams—owning market positioning, integrated campaign execution, and lifecycle marketing. A critical component of this role is the adoption and advocacy of AI‑driven marketing capabilities to enhance speed, scale, personalization, and overall marketing effectiveness. This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work. — ## Strategic Leadership & Commercial Impact – Own the development and execution of global marketing strategies and annual plans for the Chromatography portfolio. – Translate business objectives into multi‑channel demand generation programs that drive pipeline growth, customer acquisition, and revenue. – Define and evolve market positioning, segmentation, and value propositions to strengthen Repligen’s leadership in biologics production. — ## AI‑Driven Marketing Transformation – Champion the integration of AI across marketing workflows—including content generation, campaign optimization, customer segmentation, and performance analytics. – Leverage AI tools to significantly increase content velocity, personalization, and campaign efficiency while maintaining scientific accuracy. – Act as a change agent to drive adoption of AI within the marketing organization, establishing best practices and scalable processes. — ## Market Intelligence & Insights – Lead deep analysis of market trends, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and total addressable market. – Translate insights into actionable strategies that inform product positioning, campaign development, and commercial priorities. — ## Integrated Campaigns & Content Strategy – Develop and execute integrated, multi‑channel marketing campaigns across digital, technical, and field channels. – Oversee creation of high‑quality, scientifically sound content (technical collateral, digital assets, video, web, email) aligned to each stage of the customer journey. – Ensure messaging clarity, consistency, and differentiation across all touchpoints. — ## Cross‑Functional Leadership – Partner closely with Product Management, Commercial, Applications, and Marketing teams to align on strategy, execution, and performance. – Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to generate technical data and translate it into compelling customer‑facing content. – Lead and develop a small team (1 direct report), while influencing across a global, matrixed organization. — ## Performance Management & Optimization – Own marketing KPIs and budget, ensuring strong ROI and alignment with business objectives. – Utilize advanced analytics and AI‑driven insights to continuously optimize campaign performance and content effectiveness. – Report on marketing impact, pipeline contribution, and revenue outcomes to senior leadership. — ## Education & Experience – Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced scientific degree preferred. – 10+ years of marketing experience in life sciences, bioprocessing, or related industries. – Experience in chromatography or downstream bioprocessing strongly preferred. — ## Core Capabilities – Proven track record in global product commercialization and integrated marketing strategy development. – Deep expertise in segmentation, positioning, value proposition development, and go‑to‑market strategy in technical markets. – Demonstrated experience leveraging AI and digital tools to improve marketing productivity and performance. – Strong leadership and talent development experience, with the ability to influence without authority. — ## Skills & Attributes – Exceptional strategic thinking paired with hands‑on execution capability. – Ability to rapidly translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling messaging. – Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions and optimize outcomes. – Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. – Thrives in a fast‑paced, global, and highly matrixed environment. — ## Additional Information **Reports to:** Head of Global Marketing **Direct Reports:** 1 **Travel:** ~10–20% (domestic and international) — ## Success Profile This role is ideal for a marketing leader who combines strategic vision, technical fluency, and digital innovation with a passion for leveraging AI to transform marketing effectiveness. Success will be defined by the ability to drive measurable business impact, elevate marketing capabilities, and position Repligen as a trusted partner in biologics manufacturing. Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated base salary range for this role, based in the United States of America, is **$168,750–$258,750**. Compensation decisions depend on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission), and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits such as paid time off, health/dental/vision coverage, retirement benefits, and flexible spending accounts. All compensation and benefits information will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer. Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Marketing Manager
item.description: Marketing Manager Organization: Pharmaceutical Strategies Group (PSG) Location: Remote Date Posted: 07/20/2026 ## For over 30 years PSG (an EPIC‑owned company) has been singularly focused on helping clients navigate the complex and ever‑changing challenges of drug management. Through leading pharmacy intelligence and technologies, PSG saves clients billions of dollars every year with an unwavering commitment to serving as a strong industry advocate and strategic partner. PSG provides market‑leading technology and administration services for plan sponsors, employers, unions and trusts, hospitals, and health systems. Our mission is to relentlessly advocate for our clients as we partner together to develop innovative drug management solutions that deliver exceptional strategic insights, financial and clinical value. — ## Marketing Manager Overview This Marketing Manager will be responsible for utilizing educational and sales campaigns to influence revenue generation for Pharmaceutical Strategies Group (PSG), the pharmacy benefit consulting division of EPIC. You’ll leverage an understanding of the industry and target audiences to elevate content delivery, optimize channel selection, and improve results while collaborating closely with PSG’s sales leaders and subject matter experts to understand their needs, goals, and business complexities. You’ll develop programs that improve brand/product recognition, increase new business, and nurture client relationships. You’ll leverage a matrixed marketing team to plan and launch initiatives. You’re energized by translating broad, high‑priority growth opportunities into specific marketing activities. You have an eye for streamlining current processes or daily marketing operations to improve speed‑to‑market while maintaining excellent delivery. You’re inquisitive, knowing when and how to ask the right questions. You have a clear vision of key performance indicators and enjoy identifying emerging trends in social media, public relations, and other channels to achieve dynamic results. Once ignited, you move forward with confidence and passion, using data to guide your strategy. — ## Responsibilities – Collaborate with marketing and business leaders to manage and execute an annual marketing plan that achieves business goals. Present comprehensive strategic plan, editorial calendar, and channel optimization each year. – Develop and execute marketing campaigns that include the use of content (e.g., case studies, white papers, webinars), direct mail, digital marketing, and public relations. Establish measurable campaign goals and utilize various reporting mechanisms to evaluate results. – Act as liaison with business and sales leaders to target opportunities for content development and marketing innovation. Responsible for obtaining program approvals. – Build trusted, influential relationships with peers, sales leaders, and subject matter experts. – Create content management strategy to ensure messaging is clear, engaging, relevant, consistent, and actionable. – Support thought leadership program to continually increase brand/product recognition, improve sales solution awareness, and build credibility. Apply content across multiple digital and PR channels. – Maintain product positioning framework, keeping marketing, sales, and sales operations up to date on the latest positioning based on new‑to‑market innovation. – Collaborate with the public relations team to gain speaking engagements, awards, endorsements, and byline/quote opportunities. – Coordinate logistics of identified tradeshows and speaking engagements and ensure they are supported with modern presentations, displays, and handouts. – Identify and analyze key performance indicators for campaigns, public relations, population targeting, and optimization. Work with internal data teams and leadership to build KPIs and evaluate results. – Be a brand ambassador and lead by example with innovative problem‑solving and collaboration. Advocate change while keeping company goals and brand standards omnipresent. — ## Requirements – BA degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a relevant field. – 5+ years’ experience in marketing and/or communications. – B2B marketing experience with employee benefits/pharmacy experience is strongly preferred. – Extremely collaborative, working closely as part of a team and with other departments. – Strong knowledge of marketing concepts and copywriting standards across social networks, email, web and digital, print, public relations, and advertising platforms. – Able to successfully manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and perform complex tasks leveraging a variety of channels. – Experience planning and executing industry events, tradeshows, or speaking engagements, including coordination of materials, messaging, and follow‑up is strongly preferred. – Strong inclination for organization, process adherence, attention to detail, editorial guidelines, etc. – Provide clear, comprehensive instructions when writing creative briefs and submitting deliverable requirements. Ensure key elements (settings, links, databases, deadlines, etc.) are provided early to minimize rounds of edits. – Accountable for technical accuracy, testing, and performance of own work. – Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills with peers to senior leaders. – Ability to prioritize and work in a fast‑paced environment to meet tight deadlines in multiple areas. – Committed to working within project management tools accurately and consistently. – Adhere to marketing policies and priorities, nomenclature, filing systems, and general operations. – Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite. – Some travel required. — ## Compensation The national average annual salary for this role is $100,000–$120,000 in base pay, exclusive of any bonuses or benefits. The base pay offered will be determined based on experience, skills, training, certifications, and education, while also considering internal equity and market data. — ## WHY EPIC EPIC has over 60 offices and 3,000 employees nationwide – and we’re growing. It’s a great time to join the team and be a part of this growth. We offer: – Generous Paid Time Off – Managed PTO for salaried/exempt employees (personal time off without accruals or caps); 22 PTO days starting out for hourly/non‑exempt employees; 12 company‑observed paid holidays; 4 early close days – Generous leave time options: Paid parental leave, pregnancy disability and bonding leave, and organ donor/bone marrow donor leave – Employee referral bonus program of $1,500 per hired referral – Quarterly employee recognition program for demonstrating EPIC’s values plus additional employee recognition awards and programs (and trips) – Employee Resource Groups: Women’s Coalition, EPIC Veterans Group – Professional growth & development: Mentorship Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Leadership Development – Unique benefits such as Pet Insurance, Cancer Insurance, Identity Theft & Fraud Protection Coverage, Legal Planning, Family Planning, and Menopause & Midlife Support – Additional benefits include (but are not limited to): 401(k) matching, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, and wellness & employee assistance programs – 50/50 Work Culture: EPIC fosters a 50/50 culture between producers and the rest of the business, supporting collaboration, teamwork, and an inclusive work environment. It takes both production and service to be EPIC – EPIC Gives Back – charitable efforts include Donation Connection, Employee Assistance Fund, and People First Foundation – Ranked in the top 10 of property/casualty agencies according to *Insurance Journal* To learn more about EPIC, visit the Careers Page: [https://www.epicbrokers.com/about/epic-careers/] EPIC embraces diversity in all its various forms—whether diversity of thought, background, race, religion, gender, skills, or experience. We are committed to fostering a work community where every colleague feels welcomed, valued, respected, and heard. Diversity drives innovation, and creating an environment where every employee feels included and empowered helps us deliver the best outcomes to our clients. California Applicants – View your privacy rights: [https://www.epicbrokers.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/epic-ca-employee-privacy-notice.pdf] #LI-MS2 #Remote work #PSG Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Executive Vice President, Omnichannel Strategy
item.description: Executive Vice President, Omnichannel Strategy Organization: Real Chemistry Location: Remote Date Posted: 07/20/2026 ## At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human‑centred creativity, and AI‑driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact‑obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem. — ## Executive Vice President, Omnichannel Strategy Real Chemistry is seeking an Executive Vice President, Omnichannel Strategy to define, build, and lead the next generation of strategic excellence across RC Media. As a key member of the RC Media leadership team, this individual will establish the vision, operating model, and long‑term direction for Omnichannel Strategy, ensuring strategy is deeply integrated across media, analytics, activation, customer engagement, technology, and client experience. This leader will guide how strategy is delivered across the organization, helping teams translate complex business challenges into actionable, measurable customer engagement solutions. The EVP will oversee a growing team of approximately 9 strategists and will play a critical role in shaping team structure, talent development, capability‑building, and future hiring. This is an opportunity to inherit and evolve a diverse team while helping define what world‑class strategic consulting looks like within a modern healthcare media organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to executive‑level clients and internal leaders, you will partner closely with Client Experience, Analytics, Media, Activation, Technology, Medical, Creative, and Growth leaders to design connected customer experiences that drive meaningful business outcomes. You will help shape the future of omnichannel engagement at Real Chemistry while contributing to agency innovation, growth, and market differentiation. This is a hybrid role based in any of our U.S. offices, with a preference for candidates located in or near the New York metropolitan area. Exceptional candidates located elsewhere in the U.S. will also be considered, with an expectation of regular travel to collaborate with leadership teams and clients. — ## What You’ll Do – Lead and evolve the Omnichannel Strategy function, setting the vision for how strategic planning is delivered across RC Media and defining what strategy means within an increasingly integrated organization. – Build strong partnerships with Client Experience, Planning, Media, Analytics, Activation, and Technology leaders to create seamless, collaborative ways of working and eliminate silos across functions. – Develop integrated omnichannel engagement strategies that connect business objectives, customer insights, media, technology, content, and measurement frameworks into cohesive customer experiences. – Serve as a senior strategic advisor to pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare clients, helping executive stakeholders navigate evolving market dynamics and engagement opportunities. – Partner closely with Analytics, Media, and Technology teams to transform data, insights, and customer intelligence into actionable strategic recommendations. – Establish operational excellence for the Strategy function, including strategic frameworks, planning methodologies, service models, team processes, deliverables, governance structures, and cross‑functional workflows. – Ensure strategy outputs are measurable and aligned to business outcomes through robust performance frameworks and success metrics. – Lead strategic planning support across key accounts while playing an active role in new business efforts, pitches, thought leadership, and agency growth initiatives. – Mentor, coach, and develop a team of strategists, helping elevate capabilities while creating a high‑performance culture rooted in collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. – Drive innovation through the thoughtful application of AI, emerging technologies, and new customer engagement models. – Represent Real Chemistry externally through client presentations, industry events, publications, and market‑facing thought leadership. — ## This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If – You are a collaborative leader who excels at building alignment across teams and influencing stakeholders without relying on authority alone. – You understand that great strategy only creates value when it can be operationalized, activated, measured, and adopted by cross‑functional teams. – You thrive in executive‑level client environments and can confidently influence senior stakeholders. – You are energized by coaching and developing teams while helping individuals grow into their full potential. – You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and building productive relationships across media, analytics, technology, commercial, and client service teams. – You are naturally curious about the future of healthcare engagement and excited by the role technology, AI, data, and personalization will play in shaping customer experiences. – You embody Real Chemistry’s values: Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.” — ## What You Should Have – 15+ years of experience in healthcare marketing, pharmaceutical advertising, media strategy, customer engagement, consulting, omnichannel strategy, commercial excellence, or related disciplines. – Significant leadership experience within a healthcare agency, consulting organization, pharmaceutical company, media organization, or customer engagement environment. – Proven success defining and implementing strategic vision, operating models, or transformation initiatives within complex organizations. – Deep expertise in omnichannel strategy, customer journey architecture, communications planning, audience strategy, media strategy, engagement planning, and healthcare commercialization. – Practical understanding of how omnichannel programs are operationalized through technology, activation, data, and executional teams, not solely at the planning level. – Experience leading and developing high‑performing strategy teams, including coaching leaders and building scalable organizational structures. – Strong executive presence, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholder groups. – Demonstrated success partnering with analytics, technology, media, and activation teams to develop integrated customer engagement strategies. – Proven ability to lead through change and navigate ambiguity while building alignment across matrixed organizations. – Strong business development experience, including participation in pitches, organic growth initiatives, and strategic client expansion opportunities. – Demonstrated passion for innovation, AI‑enabled solutions, and emerging technologies. — ## Pay Range **$275,000–$300,000** This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Compensation will be determined based on job‑related, non‑discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. — ## Benefits & Perks Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified. We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks tailored to your region. Globally, this includes: – Offices in key markets with free snacks – Generous holiday and paid time off – Options for private medical, dental, and vision plans – Support in saving for the future – Mental wellness coaching and support – Access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning Learn more at: [www.realchemistrybenefits.com] — ## Working with Real HART Since the pandemic, we have adapted to how our people told us they want to work. We have office locations in cities in the US, UK, and Europe with many employees and clients that serve as hubs where and when they need us. For employees within an hour of one of our offices, we expect attendance in the office two days per week, either at a Real Chemistry office or onsite with clients. We are also actively opening new office locations, so if one opens near you, our Real HART policy will apply. Outside of these offices, we have regions where people work remotely but come together quarterly for collaboration, culture, and learning opportunities. We call this our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach. item.title: Lead Director – Corporate Compliance (IC)
item.description: Lead Director – Corporate Compliance (IC) Organization: CVS Health Location: Springfield, IL Date Posted: 07/20/2026 ## Description We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. ## Position Summary Senior‑level compliance position responsible for the management, execution, and oversight of the compliance program activities and deliverables of a Medicaid managed care organization operating in a highly complex regulatory environment. Oversees the activities of other compliance team members assigned to the market. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining systems and processes that demonstrate the principles of an effective Compliance program and promote compliant and ethical behavior in the assigned Medicaid health plan. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: – Serve as the designated Compliance Officer for Aetna’s IL Medicaid health plan. – Act as the primary liaison to the state Medicaid agency, facilitating compliance and contract‑related communications and activities. – Facilitate preparation for and management of external audits conducted by state Medicaid and related agencies or partners (including completion of quality reviews prior to submission) in conjunction with health plan leadership through final report and corrective action plan closure. – Lead and execute all elements of the Medicaid compliance program for Aetna’s IL Medicaid health plan. – Conduct research and develop recommendations to support compliant business operations, processes, and policies in accordance with state‑specific Medicaid program requirements. – Develop compelling, strategic, and appropriate compliance‑related communications on behalf of the health plan in response to state Medicaid agency inquiries or requests. – Maintain an in‑depth working knowledge of the health plan’s contractual, regulatory, and program policy obligations as a Medicaid managed care organization and serve as a resource to health plan and growth partner staff for education, training, and business decision‑making purposes. – Ensure that current resource tools and internal deliverables—such as contract libraries, regulatory reporting assignments, risk assessments, risk tracking lists, internal reporting systems and summaries, and other department‑wide tools—are current and accessible to business partners to support appropriate monitoring and oversight of health plan compliance processes. – Utilize systems unique to job functions, including standard‑issue software such as Microsoft products and compliance‑specific tools such as Archer; maintain system documentation, serve as subject matter expert, train users, and contribute to system design, oversight, or maintenance. – Lead and direct oversight and monitoring activities to evaluate levels of compliance with new and existing Medicaid managed care organization requirements across the business; support business partners in developing mitigation and corrective action plans and effectively escalate risks, concerns, and other issues through appropriate channels. – Maintain positive, productive relationships with internal and external senior‑level constituents to effectively communicate and influence ethical and compliant outcomes. – Oversee submission of required regulatory reports (standard and ad hoc), including completion of high‑level quality reviews prior to submission and maintenance of tracking systems and tools to document ownership, reporting requirements, and monitor timely delivery and acceptance of reports. – Provide training and guidance to less experienced team members to accomplish goals. – Other duties as assigned. ## Required Qualifications • 10+ years of previous experience in Medicaid or Medicaid managed care. • 5+ years in roles requiring project management skills and responsibilities. • 2+ years of previous management experience. ## Preferred Qualifications Audit experience. Master’s degree in Public Policy, Health Care Administration, Public Administration, similar fields, or a law degree. ## Education Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent years of related experience. ## Pay Range The typical pay range for this role is: **$100,000.00 – $231,540.00** This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full‑time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography, and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission, or short‑term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. ## Our People Fuel Our Future Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members, and communities we serve, and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. ## Great Benefits for Great People We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. ## Additional Information We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: **08/17/2026** Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. item.title: Policy Counsel
item.description: Policy Counsel Organization: Innocence Project Location: New York, NY Date Posted: 07/20/2026 # Policy Counsel ## About the Innocence Project The Innocence Project works to free the innocent, prevent wrongful convictions, and create fair, compassionate, and equitable systems of justice for everyone. Our work is guided by science and grounded in anti-racism. Since our inception, the Innocence Project has used DNA and other scientific advancements to prove wrongful conviction. To date, we have helped to free or exonerate more than 250 people who collectively spent more than 3,600 years behind bars. Our efforts have led to the passage of more than 200 transformative state laws and federal reforms. Today, the Innocence Project continues to fight for freedom, drive structural change, and advance the innocence movement. To learn more, please visit [www.innocenceproject.org]. ## About the Position The Policy Department advances the Innocence Project’s reform agenda by promoting state and federal policies that strengthen the fairness and reliability of the criminal legal system and aim to reduce the risk of wrongful convictions. The team leads advocacy campaigns across key issues, including state-level legal reforms and national efforts to improve the scientific foundation and equitable use of forensic and investigative methods. Under the leadership of the Director of Policy, the department sets reform strategy, manages campaigns and external partners, and drives progress toward ambitious policy goals while maintaining an inclusive and values-driven approach to criminal legal reform. The Policy Counsel will play a significant role in advancing the Policy Department’s policy efforts by collaborating in the development of department strategies, researching and analyzing legislation, managing in-depth legal research (including 50-state comparisons of key criminal justice statutes), analyzing recent case law and court rules, drafting and reviewing legislation, monitoring federal policy proposals, leading and managing the high court rules strategy, collaborating across departments, assisting in the development of advocacy materials, and translating complex legal issues into accurate and understandable policy messages for multiple audiences. The goal of this position is to accelerate the Policy Department’s impact in achieving transformative policy change. The Policy Counsel must be skilled at legal and policy research, collaborative, an excellent writer, detail-oriented, and highly organized. They must be self-directed, exercise sound judgment, operate independently, and possess a high degree of knowledge of legal issues impacting wrongful convictions. This position reports directly to the Director of Policy and works closely with the entire Policy team. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas and we are not an e-verify employer. The duties of this position require approximately 40 hours of work per week to be performed virtually/in-office. This position requires the ability to travel roughly 5% of the time. We currently have a hybrid in-office model, with all employees in the office three days per week and the remainder of the week remotely. Wednesday is our organization’s “anchor day” where all staff works in the office. The number of required in-office days is subject to change. ## The Ideal Candidate The Innocence Project seeks a strategic, collaborative, and mission-driven attorney with exceptional legal research, policy analysis, and writing skills, and a demonstrated commitment to criminal legal reform. The ideal candidate excels at translating complex legal issues into clear, persuasive language for a wide range of audiences in the policy setting, thrives in cross-functional and coalition-based environments, and can independently manage multiple priorities while maintaining meticulous attention to detail. They are a proactive problem-solver and an insightful thought partner with experience in legislative and court rule advocacy, a strong understanding of legal issues surrounding wrongful convictions, and the ability to build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders. In addition, the ideal candidate models our IP Values of accountability, collaboration, empathy + compassion, equity, person-centeredness, quality focus, and self-awareness. All Innocence Project employees must embrace, respect, and value the rich diversity of perspectives and lived experience of our staff. We recognize and appreciate that our work is better for having varied participants and thought partners. The ideal candidate thrives in this type of environment. ## Essential Job Functions ### Law and Policy Research – Track, monitor, and analyze proposed laws, regulations, and emerging legal developments at the federal, state, and local levels related to criminal legal legislation, particularly those affecting revealing, correcting, or preventing wrongful convictions. – Support state-based policy campaigns with research and analysis, including: – State-by-state comparisons of specific criminal justice laws and policies. – Analysis of legislation relating to IP’s policy reforms, including legislative histories and fiscal notes. – Analysis of court decisions and case law that affect our policy reform agenda. – Develop policy materials such as fact sheets for use by network partners; respond to requests for information and materials; provide relevant training for network members in settings such as webinars, the policy symposium, and the network conference. – Perform in-depth legal research and draft policy and advocacy materials, including multi-state landscapes, position papers, reports, memos, white papers, op-eds, and formal comments on proposed rulemakings. – Draft and amend legislation and proposed regulations and court rules in collaboration with state policy advocates and other staff. – Track, monitor, and report on developing areas of case law, active litigation, and court rule amendments in substantive issue areas related to the Innocence Project’s state policy agenda. – Manage the Policy Department’s library of materials and continuously update with new content; conduct periodic audits; advise the Department and Director of significant developments impacting legislative issue areas. – Assume a leading and strategic role in new Department initiatives as assigned by the Director of Policy. – Respond to inquiries by Post-conviction Litigation or Strategic Litigation staff attorneys to provide legislative history research and draft legal memoranda; collaborate with Data Science & Research projects; interface with all programmatic departments. – Draft and submit comments to state court rule proposals, amendments, and executive orders. – Advise the Policy Department on emerging legal, legislative, technological, and other developments in innocence issue areas. – Develop strategy, lead implementation, and provide resources for the Innocence Project’s court rule reform agenda; draft and submit state court rule proposals, comments, and amendments. – Synthesize and organize complex information into clear and well-written briefing materials for members of the Policy Program. – Assist the Director of Policy with managing the federal legislative agenda and executive branch orders and directives. – Assist Policy Advocates in developing support materials (including case law reviews, testimony, policy advocacy planning, and legal research) for Network partners and lobbyists as needed in service of state policy campaigns. – Aid the policy team with preparation of testimony, briefings, webinars, and other external engagements. – Develop external relationships with national criminal legal reform organizations. – Cross-Department Collaboration: Partner with internal departments—such as Strategic Litigation, Post-conviction Litigation, and Data Science and Research—to identify emerging issues and opportunities, align policy strategies, and monitor litigation developments. – Review, summarize, and educate Policy and other IP staff on relevant legislative and policy developments. – Lead hiring and supervision of legal interns, externs, and fellows. ### External Events – Assist with organizing policy-based working groups with external partners. – Attend conferences, symposia, and meetings to develop professional relationships that support the mission. – Represent the Innocence Project in coalitions, task forces, and working groups. – Serve as a legal policy resource to Innocence Network partners. – Attend legislative sessions and hearings in collaboration with state policy advocates. – Represent the Innocence Project on conference panels, webinars, podcasts, and other media. ## Qualifications & Experience – Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school is required. – Current member, in good standing, of the New York bar or eligibility for admission via motion pursuant to Section 520.10 within 6 months of start date is required. – At least 3 years of public policy experience within government or an issue-advocacy organization. – High degree of knowledge on court rule-making authority and process; familiarity with best practices and strategies for court rule advocacy. – Experience conducting policy and legal research, including ability to use LexisNexis and/or WestLaw. – Ability to travel roughly 5% of the time. – Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. ### Preferred Qualifications – Experience authoring articles, position statements, or white papers on criminal law reform and/or public policy. – Experience translating complex information and developing materials for policy initiatives or campaigns. – Experience facilitating and assisting with large-scale legal projects. – Active participation in coalitions or large groups; proven ability to synthesize group goals and collaborate effectively. ## Key Competencies + Values – Excellent written and oral communi

item.title: VP of Communications
item.description: VP of Communications Organization: Biodefense Policy Organization Location: Washington, DC Date Posted: 07/20/2026 ## Overview This is a founding role at a soon‑to‑be‑launched 501(c)(4) advocacy organization dedicated to protecting the United States from biological threats. As the organization’s first communications hire, the VP of Communications will build the organization’s public presence and narrative from the ground up. The VP will lead the organization’s brand, media, and public affairs strategy, ensuring that its mission resonates with policymakers, key stakeholders, and the public. They will help shape the national narrative around biodefense. As a senior member of the leadership team, the VP will play a key role in shaping the organization’s strategy and growth. The position reports directly to the Executive Director. ## About the Organization We are building a national policy advocacy organization dedicated to defending the United States against biological threats. As advances in biotechnology and artificial intelligence accelerate both opportunities and risks, the nation’s defenses remain fragmented and unprepared for emerging threats. We will advance a comprehensive policy agenda spanning prevention, detection, preparedness, and response to keep the U.S. safe from naturally emerging, accidental, and deliberate biothreats. We will work directly with Congress and the executive branch to turn those priorities into enacted law and policy. We will also advocate for a strong biotechnology and scientific enterprise that sustains public trust and supports U.S. competitiveness and national security. We are a bipartisan team of former senior government officials, drawing on an advisory network of senior congressional and executive branch officials, industry leaders, public health professionals, scientists, and national security experts from across the political spectrum. By partnering with the existing biodefense community and building the political momentum and rapid‑response capacity the moment demands, we intend to close critical gaps before the next crisis. ## Responsibilities – Oversee and implement a public launch strategy – Develop and execute a comprehensive communications strategy aligned with the organization’s mission and policy objectives – Establish and advance the organization’s brand, positioning, core messages, and overarching narrative – Oversee all media relations, serving as the primary point of contact for press inquiries and proactive media outreach – Develop and execute a rapid response strategy, identifying openings in the news cycle and moving quickly to advance the organization’s narrative – Plan and execute end‑to‑end earned media campaigns, from strategy through placement and follow‑through – Create high‑impact content, including press releases, op‑eds, talking points, social media content, and organizational reports – Develop executive communications and prepare senior leaders for interviews, public appearances, testimony, speeches, and other external engagements – Advise the Executive Director and leadership team on reputation management and crisis communications – Build and maintain relationships with journalists, commentators, key influencers, thought leaders, and partner organizations – Oversee the organization’s digital presence, including the website, email communications, and social media channels – Collaborate closely with policy, government affairs, and external‑engagement colleagues to support legislative and advocacy priorities – Establish systems for measuring communications reach and impact and use those findings to refine strategy – Hire and manage communications staff, consultants, external agencies, and other contractors as the organization grows ## Qualifications – Substantial senior‑level experience in communications, public relations, public affairs, political communications, or a related field, preferably in a mission‑driven, policy‑oriented, or technical environment – Significant experience in political communications, including senior campaign communications, congressional communications, executive branch communications, or equivalent, is strongly preferred – Experience leading crisis communications – Demonstrated ability to build and execute campaigns end to end, with specific examples of earned media placements, rapid response wins, or narrative‑shaping moments – Proven track record of securing coverage in top‑tier media outlets and managing complex or sensitive reputational issues – Exceptional ability to distill complex scientific, technical, or policy information into clear and compelling communications for general and policymaker audiences – Experience managing staff, external agencies, contractors, and communications budgets – Comfortable operating in a fast‑moving, build‑from‑scratch environment with limited existing infrastructure – Sound political judgment and the ability to communicate credibly across partisan and ideological lines – Deep interest in biosecurity, health, technology, or national security policy (prior experience on these topics preferred but not required) ## Compensation Compensation for this role is expected to range from $175,000–$260,000, depending on experience and qualifications. The organization will also offer a competitive benefits package. ## Interview Process – Application Review – Screening Interview – Take‑Home Exercise (Paid) – Final Round Interviews – Reference Check – Offer Apply through this link: [ https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/biodefense-policyorg/6f6e5abf-f6f7-4bbc-8614-fdcbb82e68be ] Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Government Affairs Federal Director
item.description: Government Affairs Federal Director Organization: Novo Nordisk Location: Washington, DC Date Posted: 07/21/2026 ## About the Department Novo Nordisk’s Market Access and Public Affairs team engages diverse stakeholders across political and healthcare landscapes to forge solutions that drive patient access to innovative products. We strive to deliver the best possible outcomes for patients with diabetes, obesity, growth hormone deficiencies, and rare bleeding disorders through mutual wins for both Novo Nordisk and our Market Access customers. Our passion for helping people live better lives—and our award‑winning product pipeline—can only be as effective as our ability to provide information to healthcare providers, key stakeholders, and policymakers. Our Market Access and Public Affairs professionals ensure that the latest therapies and products reach the people who need them most by creating an environment where innovation and chronic disease management drive optimal health outcomes. Are you ready to realize your potential? — ## The Position The Director, Federal Affairs augments the Senior Director, Federal Affairs in all aspects of Novo Nordisk’s federal agenda focused on Congressional House Republicans, particularly strategic goals and resource recommendations related to the Novo Nordisk Political Action Committee, trade associations, consultants, and documentation and publication tools. This role focuses on planning, communicating, advocating, and executing a proactive government affairs strategy that advances the mission and goals of Novo Nordisk’s enterprise strategy as it relates to federal legislation and policies. The Director will also work strategically to defeat or mitigate decisions or actions by the U.S. Congress and Administration that could affect our business or patients. The position is accountable for relationships with a substantial portion of the U.S. Congress and political appointees within an Administration, including communicating, advocating, and executing Novo Nordisk’s policy positions. It proactively collaborates with internal partners on all aspects of federal legislative, grassroots, and Political Action Committee goals. It also serves as one of the company’s primary contacts and advocates responsible for developing strategic lobbying plans and promoting the company’s positions directly to Congress. — ## Relationships This position reports to the Senior Director, Government Affairs. It interacts with many external parties, primarily members of the federal legislative branch—mainly House Republican leadership and Members of the health committees—political appointees of an Administration, contractors working for Novo Nordisk, and trade associations. Internal interactions include colleagues in Princeton and Copenhagen, particularly senior staff involved in forming Novo Nordisk’s positions on public policy issues. The role also engages with Congressional Republican stakeholders, including but not limited to: Republican Congressional office health staff in the House of Representatives, Chiefs of Staff, Legislative Directors, and other key congressional staff members; Committee staff of key House and Senate Committees; Leadership; NNI representatives; and others. Additional interactions include Congressional Member organizations such as the Congressional Diabetes Caucus, Republican Study Committee, House Freedom Caucus, Republican Main Street Partnership, House Republican Policy Committee, and the National Republican Congressional Committee. The Director also works with external organizations involved in Government Affairs activities related to Novo Nordisk’s interests, including PhRMA, BIO, and other industry coalitions. The role serves as Team Leader in key areas and ensures successful application and communication of all Novo Nordisk policies, procedures, and the Novo Nordisk Way. This position is based in the Washington, D.C. office. — ## Essential Functions – Develops and manages proactive strategies to mitigate risks and identify opportunities or policy goals of importance to the Company, supporting NNI business and patient legislative goals. – Tracks federal legislation and regulation affecting NNI’s businesses and works with the policy team to understand impacts and NNI’s position. – Coordinates with the Alliance Development team on cross‑functional projects involving outside organizations. – Ensures that government officials, legislative committees, and other relevant parties are aware of Novo Nordisk’s position on public affairs issues. – Initiates and cultivates relationships with federal policymakers and their staffs. Assists in developing materials and resources to support analysis of proposals and arguments regarding NNI policy positions. – Develops and implements federal strategies to advance policy positions by working closely with the policy team and internal stakeholders to establish positions related to access to pipeline and marketed products. – Participates in cross‑functional work teams—often in a leadership role—to stimulate collaboration and ensure progress toward legislative and regulatory objectives. – Develops strategies and spearheads opportunities to help grow the Novo Nordisk Political Action Committee (PAC) and support NNI activities. – Builds organizational alignment on key issues by informing and educating management and employees about external developments. – Works strategically with Federal Government Affairs consultants by developing and managing proactive strategies to mitigate risks and identify opportunities created by federal legislation. — ## Physical Requirements 20–30% overnight travel required. — ## Qualifications – Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred. – 12+ years of combined experience in federal government affairs, Capitol Hill, Administration, or lobbying consulting firm experience required. An advanced degree may substitute for 2 years of experience. – Minimum 6 years of direct federal government affairs experience in Capitol Hill, Administration, or Pharmaceutical industry. – Demonstrated analytical skills to understand legislative components and their potential effect on NNI and the industry. – Advanced knowledge of federal government affairs and public policy, including policy analysis and government relations. – Strong planning, relationship‑building, cross‑functional team, and leadership skills. – Demonstrated ability to proactively strategize to advance policy priorities. – Proven ability to cultivate relationships with key associations/agencies, Congressional leaders, and political appointees. – Ability to effectively deliver information, explain, advocate, and negotiate positions to a broad spectrum of individuals. – Ability to work under tight deadlines with minimal supervision. – Demonstrated career progression with increasing responsibility. – Strong advocacy and communication skills. – Pharmaceutical/healthcare industry experience and knowledge of diabetes and obesity preferred but not required. – Previous experience working with relevant congressional committees preferred. – Proven track record of effective strategic planning, execution, and follow‑up. – Results‑focused mindset. – Strong interpersonal and communication style with the ability to convey passion about Novo Nordisk’s public policy goals and generate enthusiasm among internal and external audiences. — ## Compensation The base compensation range for this position is $187,100 to $327,500. Base compensation is determined based on multiple factors. This position is also eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long‑term incentive compensation and/or company vehicles depending on position level and other factors. Employees are also eligible to participate in Company benefit programs including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and auto/home insurance. The Company also offers time off pursuant to its sick time policy, flex‑able vacation policy, and parental leave policy. — We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all job applicants. At Novo Nordisk, we’re not chasing quick fixes—we’re creating lasting change for long‑term health. For over 100 years, we’ve been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our curiosity and inspires us to push boundaries in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we’re making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger—a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today. Novo Nordisk is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. item.title: Counsel, Americas – Regulatory & International Legal
item.description: Counsel, Americas – Regulatory & International Legal Organization: Roblox Location: San Mateo, CA Date Posted: 07/21/2026 ## Every day on Roblox Every day, tens of millions of people come to **Roblox** to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences — all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and we’re looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. At Roblox, we believe that careers are dynamic and should be a continuous progression through challenges and opportunities that build new skills and strengths. As part of our commitment to fostering growth and development, we encourage you to learn more about this opportunity and apply if you see a potential fit. — ## Counsel for the Americas – Regulatory & International Legal As **Counsel for the Americas** on the Regulatory & International Legal team, you will advise business and legal teams on existing and emerging online safety, AI, and consumer laws in the Americas, and support regulatory engagement activities. This role reports to the Head of Americas, Regulatory & International Legal. The ideal candidate will be proactive, a quick learner, and comfortable with complex and evolving legal requirements. This is an opportunity to join a growing legal team, learn about exciting new technologies and business models, and work on novel legal issues. — ## You will – **Evaluate regulations** — Evaluate and advise on existing, pending, and developing regulations in the Americas, with a focus on online safety, AI, and consumer laws. – **Develop compliance strategies** — Develop and implement compliance strategies. – **Identify legislative trends** — Identify and educate colleagues on new legislative and regulatory trends affecting Roblox in the region. – **Respond to cross‑functional requests** — Respond to requests for advice from cross-functional teams as needed. – **Support regulatory engagement** — Support regulatory engagement activities. — ## You have – 5–7 years of relevant legal experience. – License to practice law in a US jurisdiction. – Experience working with or for a company in the social media, content, or gaming space. – Experience tracking and analyzing state and federal legislative proposals. – Experience dealing with online safety, consumer, or other relevant regulators. – Knowledge of, or interest in, regulatory landscape in the Americas (including but not limited to the US). – Strong critical judgment and analytical skills with the ability to propose solutions and translate legal analysis into practical advice, considering business needs and objectives. – Excellent organizational and prioritization skills. – The ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment. – The ability to handle a diverse and complex workload. – The ability to work collaboratively within a small, tightly‑knit team. — ## Compensation (San Mateo, CA roles) For roles based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. Actual base pay depends on job‑related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs, and market demand. In some circumstances, the actual salary may fall outside this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full‑time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits as described on this page. **Annual Salary Range** $211,760 — $252,210 USD Roles based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). — ## Equal Employment Opportunity Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process. — ## Work Authorization Notice (US roles) For US‑based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H‑1B sponsorship at this time.
