item.title: Head of Wildfire Affairs
item.description: Head of Wildfire Affairs Organization: Pano AI Location: San Francisco, CA Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## Help us tackle the growing wildfire crisis with the latest advancements in AI and IoT ## Who we are The challenge: Every minute matters in wildfire response. As climate change increases the frequency and intensity of wildfires—with longer fire seasons, drier fuels, and more extreme weather—new ignitions can spread rapidly, putting communities, critical infrastructure, and ecosystems at risk. Today, many wildfires are first reported by members of the public, meaning it can take valuable time to detect a fire, confirm its location and size, and mobilize responders. Fire agencies need faster, more reliable ways to detect, verify, and pinpoint new ignitions so they can respond quickly and prevent small fires from becoming catastrophic events. About Pano AI: Pano AI is the leader in AI-powered wildfire detection and intelligence, helping fire professionals detect, respond to, and contain wildfires faster and more safely. Our platform combines advanced hardware, software, artificial intelligence, satellite imagery, and other data sources to provide real-time situational awareness and actionable intelligence. Using a network of ultra-high-definition, 360-degree cameras positioned across high vantage points, Pano AI delivers a real-time view of wildfire activity, enabling faster, more informed decision-making when every second counts. We are a team of more than 175 people working in a hybrid-remote environment across North America and Australia, with headquarters in San Francisco. Our customers include government agencies, utilities, insurers, and private landowners who rely on Pano AI to help protect people, property, and natural landscapes. Pano AI currently serves customers across the United States, Australia, and Canada, monitoring more than 50 million acres worldwide. Our work has been recognized by Fast Company as one of the Top 10 Most Innovative AI Companies in 2023 and one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies in 2026, ranking #1 in Sustainability. We have also been named to TIME’s list of the 100 Most Influential Companies of 2025 and recognized by MIT Technology Review as one of the top climate technology companies to watch. Backed by $89 million in funding from leading investors including Giant Ventures, Liberty Mutual Ventures, Tokio Marine Future Fund, Congruent Ventures, Initialized Capital, Salesforce Ventures, and T-Mobile Ventures, we’re building technology that helps communities around the world become more resilient to wildfire. Learn more at [www.pano.ai]. ## The Role We’re looking for a highly respected wildfire professional to serve as a senior leader on wildfire community engagement and provide cross-functional company guidance. This is a unique opportunity for someone who’s built a career in wildfire, has a deep passion for innovation, and is eager to help accelerate the adoption of advanced technology in wildfire management. As a representative of Pano AI in the wildfire community, you will serve as a trusted ambassador, thought leader, and connector. You’ll engage with agencies, influence policy discussions, speak publicly on behalf of Pano, and foster strategic relationships that advance our mission. Within Pano, you’ll champion the perspectives of fire agencies and frontline personnel, ensuring their needs and operational realities inform our strategy and product direction. You’ll also lead the development of a vibrant stakeholder network, bringing together agency leaders and practitioners to drive collaboration, share knowledge, and accelerate the adoption of innovative technologies that improve wildfire detection and response. ## What you’ll do ### Wildfire Community Representation & Advocacy – **Senior voice** — Serve as Pano AI’s senior voice to the wildfire and emergency management community – **Agency relationships** — Build and deepen relationships with fire agency leaders, chiefs, and decision-makers across the U.S. – **Mission championing** — Champion Pano’s mission within the fire community and bring new voices into our network – **Public representation** — Represent Pano at national conferences, panels, agency events, and industry forums ### Partnerships & Coalition Building – **Engagement program** — Build and lead a public engagement program consisting of Pano users interested in helping accelerate technology adoption across the wildfire ecosystem – **Strategic partnerships** — Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with fire agencies, including state and federal wildland firefighters, wildfire safety organizations, utilities, and NGOs – **Coalition building** — Build coalitions that advance wildfire detection policy, funding, and technology adoption – **Hard-to-reach engagement** — Identify and engage hard-to-reach agencies and organizations ### Government Affairs & Policy – **Lobbying support** — Support lobbying efforts, legislative testimony, and engagement with policymakers – **Alliance building** — Leverage networks to build alliances and create support for wildfire detection initiatives – **Advocacy strategy** — Contribute to advocacy strategy and help shape Pano’s positioning with government stakeholders – **Stakeholder perspectives** — Deliver key perspectives from Pano customers and fire agency stakeholders to policymakers ### Senior Advisory & Product Insight – **Operational authority** — Serve as an internal authority on fire agency operations, culture, and decision-making – **Product input** — Provide ongoing input on product development and direction based on field needs, real-world applications, and agency feedback – **Integration insights** — Offer insights and advice on product integrations, partnerships with other firetech companies, and contribute to Pano’s commitment to continuous improvements – **Sales support** — Support sales and business development as a credibility validator and subject matter expert ## What you’ll bring – **15+ years experience** — 15+ years of senior experience in fire service, wildfire response, or emergency management; fire chief, battalion chief, deputy chief, or equivalent leadership background strongly preferred – **National reputation** — A national or strong regional reputation and an active network of relationships across the fire and emergency management community – **Partnership skills** — Demonstrated ability to build partnerships, coalitions, and advocacy initiatives – **Communication strength** — A natural communicator and public speaker, comfortable representing an organization at the highest levels – **Startup adaptability** — Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving startup environment, working across technical, policy, and operational teams – **Travel readiness** — Willingness to travel frequently across the U.S. Final compensation for regular full-time employees is determined by a variety of factors, including job-related qualifications, education, experience, skills, knowledge, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, regular full-time roles are eligible for equity. Benefits are tailored to local market standards and statutory requirements in the employee’s country of employment, and may include health coverage, retirement or pension contributions, and paid time off. Specific benefit details will be shared during the interview process. Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Government Relations Director
item.description: Government Relations Director Organization: Corporate Tools Location: Post Falls, ID Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## 01 / OVERVIEW Ready to work somewhere that doesn’t treat **Government Relations** like it’s a dirty word? Corporate Tools is looking for a Government Relations Director, liaison, coordinator, strategist… whatever title best describes someone who can help us work with government agencies as efficiently as possible. If having “Director” on your business card helps you get into rooms where titles matter, great. Use it. Otherwise, take your pick. What matters to us is your ability to build relationships, create strategy, and get sh*t done. We do a LOT of work with a LOT of different government agencies, and we already have lobbyists and relationships in place. We need someone who can help us make those interactions run smoothly and tie it all together. We’re looking for someone who can build the machine. ### What You’ll Actually Do – Talk to hundreds of government agencies for us across the country – Direct and coordinate the work of our lobbying teams – Develop strategies for working with governments, not against them – Represent our interests with legislators, regulators, and other movers and shakers — ## 04 / REQUIREMENTS ### Who We’re Looking For We need a driven, experienced leader with the proven ability to: – **Assemble teams.** You’ve hired, led, and developed an internal government relations function — not just managed outside lobbying firms. – **Build relationships.** You’ve advanced policy goals while maintaining strong relationships with legislators, regulators, and legislative staff. – **Navigate the policymaking process.** You’ve seen the real mechanics: committees, amendments, rulemaking, coalitions, and legislative timing. Experience with model law ecosystems like the Uniform Law Commission is a plus. – **Shape policy strategy.** You’ve developed long‑term strategy, anticipated legislative developments, and executed multi‑step advocacy plans. – **Earn credibility with policymakers.** You’ve represented organizations effectively in meetings with legislators, regulators, and key stakeholders. – **Work across jurisdictions.** You’ve led or coordinated multi‑state legislative and regulatory efforts and understand that every jurisdiction has its own rules, pace, and personality. ### How To Get This Job There are a lot of people working in Government Relations. If you want to stand out, show us how you’ve actually done the things we’re looking for. Send us a cover letter and tell us what you’ve accomplished. Real examples beat buzzwords every time. We embrace change, learn fast, and grow from failure. Tell us how you do the same. Our Company Principles shape how we hire people and how we treat our clients and customers. As part of your application, we ask you to tell us which two of our principles resonate with you most and why. — ## Company Principles ### Freedom Not Fear Alignment and empowerment beat control, every time. ### We Learn From Our Mistakes No blame game. Make the call, learn, move. ### Pursue High Standards Low‑quality work doesn’t ship here. Standards stay high. ### Push and Support Getting outside your comfort zone isn’t a threat; it’s the job. ### We’re Scrappy The polish to sit in any room; the edge to want to win it. ### This is Our Sport Show up daily and treat the work like the big game. — ## Why Work Here ### Why You’ll Love This Job You like people. You like solving problems. You’d rather make things work than make things worse. Some might call a job like this “greasing the wheels”… we call it making sure the wheels don’t come off. We help over 5 million businesses in the US start and stay in business. A lot of what we do depends on making complicated systems a little less painful, and a lot more workable. If that sounds satisfying to you, we think you’ll really like working here. Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Senior Manager Regulatory Affairs, Global Reg Strategy US & Canada – Immunology
item.description: Senior Manager Regulatory Affairs, Global Reg Strategy US & Canada – Immunology Organization: AbbVie Location: Florham Park, NJ Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## About AbbVie AbbVie’s mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people’s lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience — and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit [www.abbvie.com]. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. — ## Job Description The Senior Manager Regulatory Affairs, Global Reg Strategy US & Canada (Hybrid) is responsible for the development and implementation of US and Canada regulatory strategic and tactical planning (RSTP) for assigned on‑market products or those in development. They ensure that regulatory strategies defined within the GRPT are effectively implemented and maintained in line with changing regulatory and business needs. This individual identifies and gathers data needed to support filings, responses to inquiries, and registration maintenance to enable commercialization of products that are developed, manufactured, or distributed to meet relevant US and Canada regulatory requirements. — ## Responsibilities – Responsible for a product(s) or products with multiple driver indications within a Therapeutic Area and supports the Manager (Global Regulatory Lead (GRL), Associate Director, or Director) in the development and execution of the regulatory strategy. – Assigned matters may have a moderate impact on business activities and operations. – Serves as HA liaison and interfaces with FDA for meetings, teleconferences, and coordinates preparation and completion of FDA meeting briefing packages and responses. – Advises internal customers who may contribute to regulated communication on Regulatory/FDA issues including Public Affairs, Clinical Development, Legal, and others such as Commercial. – Functions independently in negotiation and decision‑making for project‑related issues that have cross‑functional impact. – Assists in the development and training of staff members. – Key contributor responsible for the preparation and review of regulatory submissions consistent with US and Canada regulatory requirements and guidelines, and assures complete and timely response to Health Authorities during application review. – Supports the regulatory submission and approval process. – Broadly applies regulatory/technical knowledge of government regulations and skills across therapeutic areas. – Recommends and implements changes to difficult projects based on knowledge and expertise, accurate interpretation of US and Canada government regulations, guidances, as well as corporate policies and management‑related considerations. – Presents pertinent regulatory information to appropriate cross‑functional areas. – Operates in compliance with regulations, company policies, procedures, and guidance in alignment with regulatory product strategy and the Quality Dossier Program (QDP). — ## Qualifications ### Minimum Qualifications – Bachelor’s degree (pharmacy, biology, chemistry, pharmacology or related). – 6 years Regulatory, R&D, or Industry‑related experience. – Experience working in a complex and matrix environment. – Experience interfacing with government regulatory agencies. ### Preferred Qualifications – 2–3 years in pharmaceutical regulatory activities. – Global regulatory experience is a plus. – Advanced Degree a plus. – Certifications a plus. ### Other Required Skills – Excellent negotiation skills, problem‑solving skills, and ability to build consensus. – Effective communication skills in written and oral channels both within Regulatory and across the organization. – Able to deliver challenging messages effectively without compromising important business relationships. – Proven skill at implementing successful US and Canada regulatory strategies. — ## Additional Information Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. This job is eligible to participate in our long‑term incentive programs. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company’s sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law. AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. item.title: Manager – Regulatory/Legis
item.description: Manager – Regulatory/Legis Organization: Gexa Energy Location: Houston, TX Date Posted: 08/11/2026 **At Gexa Energy**, a NextEra Energy Resources company, we provide reliable, low‑cost energy solutions. Focused on customer satisfaction, we offer innovative electricity plans tailored to the diverse needs of Texas homes and businesses. If you’re passionate about making a difference in the energy industry and delivering exceptional customer experiences, join our team today. — ## Position Specific Description At NextEra Energy, we are adding a new **Manager Regulatory Affairs** to support our growing retail electricity and natural gas businesses. Regulatory is a key partner in growing the mass market and C&I customer businesses. In this role, you will review and analyze direct and digital marketing campaigns, with strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory rules for customer enrollments, marketing, and other related customer protection rules in competitive electric and gas markets. You will advise and counsel on new products and product structures and compliance with changing regulatory rules and varying political environments. Collaborate closely with the internal legal team to integrate legal and regulatory compliance and deal structuring. Work with broad‑based client groups and serve as the day‑to‑day regulatory lead for retail electricity and electricity projects. Identify and communicate significant risks succinctly to senior management. Stay abreast of changing market rules and inform impacted internal business clients accordingly. Lead through industry trade associations to advocate for positions that support NextEra’s business interests. Provide regulatory guidance on a variety of key growth initiatives, including M&A efforts. This role will report to the Executive Director of Regulatory & Compliance. Be a true business partner driving growth in a collaborative team. Apply today to be a part of it. — ## Job Overview Employees in this role assist in the representation of the company’s interests in regulatory bodies, regional transmission and planning organizations, and legislatures in the United States or provincial and federal political spheres in Canada. — ## Job Duties & Responsibilities – Participates in stakeholder processes, regulatory bodies, and/or regional organizations – Lobbies legislatures – Formulates company strategies internally for communication in the marketplace – Completes long‑range strategic planning – Performs other job‑related duties as assigned — ## Required Qualifications – Bachelor’s or Equivalent Experience – Experience: 7+ years — ## Preferred Qualifications – Bachelor’s Degree – Master’s – Business Administration — NextEra Energy offers a wide range of benefits to support our employees and their eligible family members. — **Employee Group:** Exempt **Employee Type:** Full Time **Job Category:** Legal/Regulatory/External Affairs **Organization:** Gexa Energy, LP **Relocation Provided:** No — NextEra Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, age, national origin, religion, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetics, disability, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by law. NextEra Energy provides reasonable accommodation in its application and selection process for qualified individuals, including accommodations related to compliance with conditional job offer requirements, consistent with federal, state, and local laws. Supporting medical or religious documentation will be required where applicable and permitted by applicable law. To request a reasonable accommodation, please send an e‑mail to [email protected] , providing your name, telephone number, and the best time for us to reach you. NextEra Energy will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. NextEra Energy does not accept any unsolicited resumes or referrals from any third‑party recruiting firms or agencies. Please see our policy for more information. item.title: Director, Data Center Community Relations
item.description: Director, Data Center Community Relations Organization: DC BLOX Location: Atlanta, GA Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## At DC BLOX At DC BLOX, we’re shaping the future of digital infrastructure. Our mission is to empower businesses with robust, secure, and reliable solutions that enable them to thrive in an increasingly connected world. Founded on the principles of innovation, integrity, and customer‑centricity, DC BLOX provides cutting‑edge colocation, cloud services, and network solutions tailored to our clients’ unique needs. Our team is made up of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence. We foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture where every voice is valued and innovation is encouraged. Whether you’re an experienced industry veteran or just starting your career, DC BLOX offers a range of opportunities for growth and development. — ## Description Summary The Director, Data Center Community Relations serves as the primary ambassador and local representative for the company in communities where data center development, construction, or operations are planned and currently exist. This role is responsible for building trust, fostering positive relationships, and maintaining open communication with local government leaders, community stakeholders, media, and residents. The Community Relations Director ensures the company remains informed about local sentiment while effectively communicating the company’s vision, investments, and commitment to the community before project development, during construction, and after project completion. — ## Essential Duties ### Community Relations – Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and the local community. – Develop and maintain strong relationships with elected officials, municipal leaders, economic development organizations, and other influential community stakeholders and influencers including schools, sports organizations, church leaders, etc. – Represent the company at community, civic, business, and media events. – Foster trust and credibility through consistent engagement and transparent communication. – Work with Public Affairs Director to initiate and coordinate engagement with government officials. – Present the company’s Community Promise and align commitments to meet specific community needs. ### Public Engagement – Plan, organize, and participate in town hall meetings, chamber meetings, HOA/neighborhood meetings, stakeholder forums, and community outreach events. – Engage and align appropriate company teams including government affairs, marketing, finance, and construction to meet and address local community needs and requests. – Address community questions and concerns and seek feedback related to data center development and operations. – Ensure community stakeholders are informed about project milestones, benefits, and impacts. ### Media and Public Communications – Establish and maintain relationships with local media outlets and journalists. – Serve as a spokesperson or coordinate media engagement in partnership with corporate communications teams. – Support proactive and responsive communications regarding company activities, announcements, and community initiatives. – Monitor media coverage and public discourse related to company projects and the broader data center industry. ### Market Intelligence and Stakeholder Monitoring – Manage the market intelligence process for identifying key stakeholders and influencers and measuring community sentiment ahead of market engagement. – Maintain an ongoing pulse of the local market by monitoring community sentiment, political developments, economic trends, and stakeholder priorities. – Identify emerging opportunities, risks, concerns, or issues that could affect company reputation or project success. – Provide regular updates and strategic insights to company leadership regarding local conditions and stakeholder perspectives. ### Community Investment and Sponsorship Management – Build relationships with nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, workforce development programs, and community groups. – Identify opportunities for and administer local community investment programs and sponsorship initiatives. – Evaluate and approve sponsorship requests within established guidelines and budgets. – Ensure community investments align with company objectives and local priorities. — ## Education / Training / Experience – Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Public Administration, Political Science, Business, Economic Development, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. – 7+ years of experience in community relations, public affairs, government relations, economic development, corporate communications, or stakeholder engagement. – Demonstrated success building relationships with government officials, community leaders, and media organizations. – Strong public speaking, facilitation, and presentation skills. – Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. – Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups and navigate complex public issues. — ## Preferred Skills – Experience in data center development, telecommunications, utilities, energy, infrastructure, commercial real estate, or economic development. – Familiarity with local government processes, land‑use considerations, permitting environments, and community engagement practices. item.title: Manager, Forest Productivity and Optimization
item.description: Manager, Forest Productivity and Optimization Organization: Rayonier Location: Yulee, FL Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## Company Overview Come grow with us! We are One Rayonier, a team that works together to create value by prioritizing safety, challenging the status quo, giving back to our communities, and driving innovation through continuous learning. With nearly 100 years of experience, we’re still discovering new ways to make lives better with our trees, our land, and — our most important resource — our people. At Rayonier, we strive to create an employee experience where you feel valued and proud to be part of our team. We foster a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment that celebrates your unique talents and perspectives. Experience the Rayonier difference: We’re big enough to offer exciting career paths, but small enough for you to know your colleagues by name. Come join a team that empowers you to make a difference! Are you ready to drive the future of forest management? As the Manager, Forest Productivity & Optimization, you will champion efforts to enhance the efficiency, productivity, and long-term sustainability of our forestry operations. In this role, you will lead high-impact process improvement projects, leverage data analysis to uncover optimization opportunities, and establish operational best practices across the organization. You will serve as the vital technical link between research and practice — translating tree improvement, nutrition, and silvicultural research into actionable field strategies that empower our foresters and maximize timberland value. — ## How You Will Contribute **Operational Optimization:** Identify and implement strategies to improve operational efficiency, productivity, and resource allocation while eliminating process bottlenecks. **Process Improvement & Best Practices:** Structure and manage continuous improvement projects; develop and scale cost-efficiency initiatives across forestry operations. **Field Research & Applied Innovation:** Design and implement field trials to evaluate emerging technologies, silvicultural practices, tree improvement, and forest nutrition. Manage and mentor contractors and employees involved in research activities. **Research Cooperative Collaboration:** Partner with university and industry research cooperatives, coordinating activities to maximize operational and financial benefits. **Data & Analytics:** Collect and analyze financial and operational forestry data to identify trends, establish benchmarks, and drive strategic decision-making. **Financial Stewardship:** Oversee project budgets and forecasts, maintain strict cost controls, and perform quarterly variance reporting. **Technology Transfer:** Act as a technical advisor to silviculture managers, field foresters, and contractors, ensuring research findings are effectively adopted in daily operations. **Safety & Sustainability:** Actively promote our culture of Safety. Ensure all productivity initiatives integrate our sustainability commitments and environmental stewardship goals. — ## What You Bring to the Team **Education:** A Bachelor’s degree in Forestry, Forest Management, or a related field. A Master of Science in Forestry or a related discipline preferred. **Experience:** Minimum of five (5) years of experience in forestry operations or an M.S. in Forestry or closely related field with a minimum of three (3) years of experience. Knowledge and experience in one or more sub-disciplines of Forestry, such as genetics, soils, biometrics, entomology, or pathology is desired. **Core Forestry Knowledge:** Strong understanding of silvicultural practices, harvesting operations, and forest management principles. **Industry Acumen:** Knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in forest management. **Technical Skills:** Strong GIS skills with experience in ArcGIS Enterprise Systems. Analytical skills including statistical analysis of forestry data with R. Experience with MS Office programs including Word and Excel. **Project & Process Management:** Experience with data analysis, process improvement methodologies, and project management. Ability to independently manage projects and initiatives, establish priorities, and proactively seek direction when needed to ensure alignment with business objectives. **Other Requirements:** Valid driver’s license required. Ready to bridge the gap between advanced forestry research and operational excellence? Apply today to shape the next generation of sustainable land management at Rayonier. — ## Working Conditions and Physical Requirements This role is physically active, requiring regular movement throughout the day both indoors and outdoors. A portion of the role involves working in an office setting, utilizing computers and other standard office equipment, alongside regular travel to field locations or industry events. Field responsibilities include time spent working alone outdoors in remote forest locations in various weather conditions, including extreme temperatures, wind, and precipitation. This requires extensive walking, hiking, and traversing various landscapes — including uneven ground, slopes, wetlands, and dense vegetation — as well as carrying equipment and supplies, including transporting tools, gear, and other necessary items over variable distances. — ## What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, accident, disability, identity theft protection, and paid parental and caregiver leave. We also offer a health savings account, a dependent care spending account, and an employee assistance plan. We provide wellness reimbursements, employee discount programs, annual health screenings, wellness incentives, wellness seminars, and financial counseling and planning tools. Our 401(k) retirement savings plan includes company matching contributions (60% match on the first 6% of base and bonus deferrals) as well as a 3% enhanced retirement contribution that does not require an employee contribution. We recognize the importance of work-life integration and offer flexible work schedules and hybrid work-from-home options (for most positions), along with a minimum of three weeks paid vacation, five paid personal days, 11 paid holidays, and paid sick leave each year. We provide a comprehensive employee development program which includes career planning tools and resources, a mentoring program, leadership development, training programs, and an 80% tuition reimbursement. item.title: Director, Public Affairs
item.description: Director, Public Affairs Organization: Rayonier Location: Atlanta, GA Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## Company Overview Come grow with us! We are **One Rayonier**, a team that works together to create value by prioritizing safety, challenging the status quo, giving back to our communities, and driving innovation through continuous learning. With nearly 100 years of experience, we’re still discovering new ways to make lives better with our trees, our land, and — our most important resource — our people. At Rayonier, we strive to create an employee experience where you feel valued and proud to be part of our team. We foster a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment that celebrates your unique talents and perspectives. Experience the Rayonier difference: We’re big enough to offer exciting career paths, but small enough for you to know your colleagues by name. Come join a team that empowers you to make a difference! Are you a strategic leader who excels at navigating complex public policy, shaping legislative outcomes, and building powerful community relationships? Do you have a passion for formulating public affairs strategies that accelerate revenue opportunities, reduce corporate liabilities, and enhance company reputation? We are seeking a **Director of Public Affairs (Western Region)** to lead our state and local government relations, public policy advocacy, and strategic community engagement. In this role, you will manage all aspects of our advocacy campaigns across Idaho, Arkansas, Texas, Washington, and Louisiana, ensuring tight alignment with regional business units while fostering an environment in which Rayonier can operate profitably. — ## How You Will Contribute Reporting to Public Affairs Leadership, you will drive our success across several critical areas: ### Strategic Advocacy Leader Translate business objectives into clear regional policy priorities, legislative strategies, and advocacy campaigns that protect and increase asset value. ### Government & Industry Champion Build and leverage a strong network of state and local elected officials, regulatory agencies, and industry trade associations to shape policies that support timberlands, wood products, real estate, and energy/minerals. ### Governance & Compliance Monitor Manage political giving budgets while maintaining strict oversight of campaign finance and ethics laws across multiple state and local jurisdictions. ### Collaborative Advisor & Storyteller Partner with internal communications teams and external PR agencies to develop compelling communication tools and messaging that support our regulatory positions and highlight our work as a trusted corporate neighbor. — ## Key Accountabilities ### Legislative Strategy & Public Policy Track legislation, provide testimony, and actively engage in the legislative process to shape policy outcomes beneficial to Rayonier and the industry. Formulate strategies to improve revenue opportunities, reduce corporate liabilities and expenses, and protect company assets across ID, AR, TX, WA, and LA. Direct contract lobbying consultants to ensure execution against their scope of work and maximize return on investment. Oversee political giving budgets in full compliance with state and local ethics and campaign finance laws. ### Cross-Functional Engagement & Stakeholder Relations Collaborate closely with regional managers across timberlands, wood products, real estate, energy, and minerals to identify key issues and revenue opportunities. Develop strong working relationships with government agencies regulating land use, air, water, wildlife, and regional economic development. Build collaborative relationships with key industry trade associations in the timber, real estate, wood products, and energy sectors. Represent the company at legislative hearings, political fundraisers, community boards, and industry public events. ### Strategic Communications & Community Engagement Partner with communications teams and external public relations agencies to develop effective advocacy materials, strategic messages, and PR tools. Collaborate with regional teams to drive strategic community affairs programs and foster mutually beneficial relationships with local constituencies. Promote corporate goodwill through public outreach programs such as National Forest Products Week, Earth Day, Arbor Day, and school partnerships. — ## What You Bring to the Team ### Required Qualifications **Education:** A Bachelor’s degree in Public Affairs, Political Science, Communications, Business, Natural Resources, or a related field. **Experience:** A minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in public affairs, government relations, issues management, coalition building, community affairs, or strategic communications. **Regional Network & Knowledge:** An existing network of contacts with state and local officials in Idaho, Arkansas, or Texas, and a strong understanding of the legislative processes and political dynamics across ID, AR, TX, WA, and LA. **Strategic Mindset & Professional Influence:** Superior capacity to convey personal trust and credibility, exercise good judgment, and maintain sensitive discussions in strict confidence. Exceptional written and verbal communication, time management, and stakeholder collaboration skills. **Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. ### Preferred Qualifications Experience in natural resource policy, government agencies/executive branch, industry associations, or contract lobbying. Proven background in strategic communications, public relations, and multi-project management. — ## Working Conditions and Physical Requirements This role is based in Atlanta, GA and requires extensive travel to meetings, hearings, and site visits outside the office. May include occasional exposure to forest environments and wood products and lumber manufacturing facilities. — ## What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, accident, disability, identity theft protection, and paid parental and caregiver leave. We also offer a health savings account, a dependent care spending account, and an employee assistance plan. We provide wellness reimbursements, employee discount programs, annual health screenings, wellness incentives, wellness seminars, and financial counseling and planning tools. Our 401(k) retirement savings plan includes company matching contributions (60% match on the first 6% of base and bonus deferrals) as well as a 3% enhanced retirement contribution that does not require an employee contribution. We recognize the importance of work-life integration and offer flexible work schedules and hybrid work-from-home options (for most positions), along with a minimum of three weeks paid vacation, five paid personal days, 11 paid holidays, and paid sick leave each year. We provide a comprehensive employee development program which includes career planning tools and resources, a mentoring program, leadership development, training programs, and an 80% tuition reimbursement. item.title: Director of Government Affairs
item.description: Director of Government Affairs Organization: DZYNE Technologies Location: Washington, DC | Fairfax, VA Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## About DZYNE DZYNE Technologies is leading the future of autonomous defense. Based in Irvine, California, we develop and manufacture advanced airborne and ground-based defense solutions deployed in over 50 countries. Backed by U.S. Government Programs of Record, our technologies are field‑proven, scalable, and production‑ready. We’re growing fast and looking for innovators ready to make an impact. At DZYNE, you’ll join a culture built on collaboration, integrity, and purpose. We celebrate wins, value diverse perspectives, and support every team member’s success. Ready to do work that matters? Join us. — ## Position Title: Director of Government Affairs **Location:** Washington, D.C. / Fairfax, VA **Work Arrangement:** Remote — ## Position Summary The Director of Government Affairs leads Ondas Sentinel’s engagement with the United States Congress across the annual defense authorization and appropriations cycles. This position owns the company’s legislative calendar end to end: developing policy and engagement strategy aligned with Ondas Sentinel equities, submitting programmatic and appropriations requests, drafting supporting white papers and technical justifications, and building durable relationships with the defense committees and with member offices representing districts and states where Sentinel facilities and workforce are located. In concert with the VP of Washington Operations, the Director serves as the company’s primary interface with professional staff on the defense subcommittees and personal office staff, translating Sentinel’s counter‑UAS, autonomous systems, and stratospheric ISR portfolio into actionable legislative outcomes — funding lines, authorization language, and report direction that advance company programs. — ## Required Duties and Responsibilities ### Appropriations and Authorization Cycle Leadership – Own the annual legislative battle rhythm across the NDAA and defense appropriations cycles, including member request windows, subcommittee and full committee markups, floor action, and conference. – Develop, draft, and submit appropriations requests and NDAA legislative proposals, including programmatic increases, new‑start justifications, and report language aligned to company program elements and procurement lines. – Analyze funding and policy trends within the USG. Author white papers, one‑pagers, and technical justification packages tailored to professional staff members and member offices, collaborating with program management and engineering leadership to ensure technical accuracy. – Track marks, report language, and bill text across House and Senate vehicles; identify deltas between chamber positions and develop conference strategy to protect and advance company priorities. – Monitor and engage on supplemental appropriations, reconciliation vehicles, and continuing resolution dynamics affecting company funding lines. ### Committee and Member Office Relationships – Build and maintain relationships with professional staff on the House and Senate Appropriations Subcommittees on Defense (HAC‑D, SAC‑D) and the House and Senate Armed Services Committees (HASC, SASC), including relevant subcommittees with jurisdiction over tactical air and land forces, intelligence and special operations, and emerging threats. – Develop and sustain relationships with member offices representing states and districts where Sentinel maintains facilities, workforce, or significant supplier presence, positioning the company as a constituent employer and technology partner. – Arrange and staff congressional engagements including member and staff briefings, facility visits, technology demonstrations, and testimony preparation for company executives. – Coordinate delegation visits to company sites and support district‑level engagement in partnership with facility leadership. ### Strategy and Internal Coordination – Provide legislative intelligence and analysis to the CEO, CTO, and Government Affairs leadership, including assessments of budget posture, committee dynamics, and legislative risk to company programs. – Coordinate legislative strategy with the company’s USG program engagement, regulatory affairs, and international efforts to ensure unified messaging across the government customer set. – Collaborate with outside consultants and lobbying firms supporting the legislative portfolio; coordinate with Ondas Sentinel compliance adherence to the Lobbying Disclosure Act, gift and ethics rules, and company policy. – Maintain the company’s legislative tracking system covering bill status, funding lines, report language, and member correspondence. — ## Required Skills / Qualifications – 6+ years of progressively responsible experience in congressional affairs, with direct experience on or with the defense committees (HAC‑D, SAC‑D, HASC, SASC) as professional staff, personal office staff handling defense portfolios, or in a corporate/association legislative role focused on defense. – Demonstrated record of securing appropriations adds, authorization language, or report direction for defense programs. – Fluency in the DoD budget justification process, including R‑1/R‑2 and P‑1 exhibit structures, program element architecture, and the relationship between the President’s Budget request and congressional action. – Working knowledge of the defense acquisition landscape, including rapid acquisition pathways, other transaction authorities, and the interplay between authorization and appropriation. – Strong writing ability, with a portfolio of white papers, request justifications, or similar legislative work products. — ## Preferred Skills / Qualifications – Subject‑matter familiarity with counter‑UAS, unmanned systems, ISR, or electromagnetic spectrum policy. – Established relationships with defense subcommittee professional staff and with delegations relevant to company facility locations. – **Clearance Level Required:** Secret — Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance, as required for the role. — ## Travel Required Yes — Up to 20% — ## Working Conditions The diversity of work conditions may range from an environment where there is little or no physical discomfort, such as a general office environment, to warehouse and other facilities. — ## Export Control / ITAR Requirement This position requires access to information and technology subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). As a result, employment is contingent upon meeting applicable export control eligibility requirements and compliance obligations. — ## Work Authorization Requirement Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full‑time basis without the need for current or future employment visa sponsorship. — ## Salary **$175,000 – $180,000 annually** Salary depends on relevant work experience, education, training, essential skills, and/or other factors such as specialized or high‑demand professions. In addition to the annual salary, the position will be eligible for an annual bonus. The pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of salary or annual bonus. — ## Benefits Our benefits are DZYNE’ed for your overall health and financial wellness. DZYNE offers a comprehensive healthcare benefits package. Base dental, vision, life, accident, disability, and other core benefits are fully covered by DZYNE. DZYNE provides paid time off and paid holidays. Additionally, DZYNE offers a 401(k) plan with an employer match and immediate vesting. DZYNE Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, DZYNE Technologies complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which our company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. — #LIREMOTE **Pay Range:** $175,000 – $180,000 per year Learn more here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Government Relations Coordinator
item.description: Government Relations Coordinator Organization: 340B Health Location: Washington, DC Date Posted: 08/11/2026 ## Government Relations Coordinator 340B Health has an immediate opening for a Government Relations Coordinator at our thriving national nonprofit health care trade association. As a member of the Government Relations team, you will support efforts to shape the strategies and tactics to effectively represent the organization on Capitol Hill, with the administration, and throughout the 340B provider community. The **Government Relations Coordinator** will play an integral role in our government relations activities and collaborate with 340B Health member hospitals to engage in advocacy. — ## Primary Responsibilities – **Lobby day support** — Assist the Director of Grassroots in executing two lobby day events per year for member hospitals, including event logistics, program and materials preparation, participant recruitment, and post‑event analysis and follow‑up. – **Calendar management** — Maintain GR team calendars and coordinate meeting invitations. – **Meeting coordination** — Arrange and support meetings and calls with members, outside consultants, and other stakeholders, managing all scheduling logistics and agendas. – **Member hospital engagement** — Assist the Director of Grassroots in working with member hospitals to develop and share with policymakers the impact 340B has on their hospitals and patients. – **Legislative monitoring** — Monitor and inform staff via our government relations platform of 340B activity on Capitol Hill, including legislation, hearings, and other congressional activity impacting the 340B program. – **Champions Recognition Program** — Assist the Director of Grassroots in administering the program. – **Federal Advocacy Toolkit** — With the Director of Government Relations, update and maintain the association’s Federal Advocacy Toolkit web content. – **GR project support** — Support and contribute to Government Relations projects including newsletters, webinars, and action alerts. – **Database maintenance** — Maintain the government relations database. – **Conference assistance** — Attend and assist with bi‑annual conferences. – **Writing and editing** — Assist with developing and editing government relations written material, such as talking points, policy summaries, PowerPoint presentations for lobby days, and government relations webinars. — ## Education and Experience – Bachelor’s degree required. – Professional experience in a legislative setting or in government relations is a plus. — ## Skills and Abilities – Strong writing and communication skills. – Strong attention to detail. – Knowledge of Congress and the legislative process preferred. – Commitment to schedules, deadlines, and high‑quality work product. – Strong organizational and time‑management skills. – Experience using the Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). — ## Other Pertinent Information – Staff are currently required to work in the office a minimum of 3 days per week, Monday–Wednesday, and other days as needed, and must live in MD, DC, or VA. No exceptions. – Overnight and out‑of‑state travel required, including to twice‑yearly conferences. – May occasionally be required to lift and carry light materials, up to twenty‑five pounds. — ## How to Apply To apply, please visit the ** 340B Health Career Center ** to access the online application process for this position. — ## About the Organization 340B Health assists safety‑net hospitals in providing services to more patients with low incomes and those living in rural areas. The organization focuses on protecting the federal 340B drug pricing program so it continues to play its critical role in subsidizing the health care safety net. — ## Additional Information As a small staff organization, 340B Health supports a collaborative working environment and recognizes the importance of each position’s value in meeting organizational goals. 340B Health offers an exceptional compensation package including health, dental, life insurance, disability insurance, paid time off, retirement plan matching, and more. Annual salary range: **$56,000–$75,000**, based on experience. The organization strives to create a meaningful work environment for all employees, one in which diverse teams and diverse ideas are valued. 340B Health encourages applications from all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring great people from a wide variety of backgrounds helps keep the organization vital and strong. Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Legal Operations & Contracts Specialist
item.description: Legal Operations & Contracts Specialist Organization: Qlik Location: King of Prussia, PA | Boston, MA Date Posted: 08/12/2026 ## What makes us Qlik? A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights, driving strategic business outcomes. Serving over 40,000 global customers, our portfolio leverages pervasive data quality and advanced AI/ML capabilities that lead to better decisions, faster. We excel in integration and governance solutions that work with diverse data sources, and our real-time analytics uncover hidden patterns, empowering teams to address complex challenges and seize new opportunities. ## The Legal Operations & Contracts Specialist Role Qlik is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Legal Operations & Contracts Specialist to provide operational and commercial support for the Legal Department. The ideal candidate will have some experience administering legal systems, including contract lifecycle management (CLM) and matter management, and knowledge of legal use cases for AI. This role will be responsible for working with IT to manage the legal team’s technology stack, producing KPI reporting, supporting cross-functional projects, and providing transactional support. The successful candidate will be able to effectively collaborate with various internal teams and external clients, which may include IT, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance. ## What makes this role interesting? – Support management of the legal department’s systems, including contract lifecycle management (CLM), eSignature, eCustoms and matter management platforms. – Act as an operations liaison between Legal and other functions, gathering business requirements for change requests, demands, and projects that impact the legal space. – Serve as a primary point of contact for the submission and management of IT service requests to support legal and corporate needs. – Manage relationships with legal technology and compliance vendors, including regular check-ins to review performance and resolve open issues. ## Here’s how you’ll be making an impact: – Own recurring legal department reporting, including KPI reporting and matter management analytics. – Maintain and update digital resources, such as web-based forms and knowledge center documentation to reflect changes to policies and templates. – Review and negotiate various agreements, including NDAs, assignments, vendor, software and SaaS. – Provide support for export control compliance checks. – Provide practical and decisive guidance to internal business teams to address contract-related inquiries and issues. ## We’re looking for a teammate with: – Bachelor’s Degree – At least 5 years of legal operations, contracts management, contract negotiation or other comparable experience within an in-house legal department. – Hands-on experience administering legal technology systems (e.g. Docusign CLM). – Working knowledge of standard commercial contract terms and agreements. – Attention to detail and accuracy in reporting, contract/process review, and analysis. – Passionate about technology and energized by the challenges of serving a dynamic and global growth company in a cutting-edge sector. – Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal) and able to engage effectively with all levels of employees and management. – Detail-oriented, organized, efficient and resourceful with strong follow-through skills. – Team player with a positive, “can do” attitude who works collaboratively with other members of the global legal team and with internal and external clients. – Able to manage multiple workloads and shifting priorities within a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment. ## The location for this role is: **Office Location:** King of Prussia, PA – USA (Hybrid) strongly preferred or Boston, MA **Hybrid:** #LI-Hybrid Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities! ## More about Qlik and who we are: Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page. ## What else do we offer? – Named in Newsweek’s ‘Americas Greatest Workplaces 2025’: [https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-workplaces-2025] – Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs. – Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness. – Flexible, diverse, and international work environment. Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs. ## Salary and Benefits The anticipated base salary range for this role is $110,000.00 USD MIN – $125,000.00 USD MAX per year. Final compensation offered by Qlik will be based on factors such as the candidate’s location, job-related skills, education, experience, and other business and organizational needs. This position is eligible for comprehensive benefits, including—but not limited to—medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, paid parental/maternity leave, participation in a 401(k) program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. ## Application Window The application window is 60 days, but applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The posting will be removed before the application window closes if the position is filled. ## Additional Notices For positions in Massachusetts: It is unlawful to require or administer a lie detector test for employment. Violators are subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Qlik is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to fostering a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and related medical conditions, genetic information, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For United States applicants and employees, go to the US Department of Labor’s website to review the Equal Employment Opportunity Posters, including the “Know Your Rights” and “Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination” posters. If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to [email protected] . Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik’s Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests. Qlik uses artificial intelligence (e.g. Talent Intelligence developed by Eightfold) to screen and summarize resumes, assess and evaluate candidates, and score candidates for all positions at Qlik. Any hiring decision will involve a human review, and you will not be subject to decisions based solely on automated means. For questions about this tool, contact [email protected] . Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means. Apply here Earn a certificate with the Council! Start your journey today. item.title: Government Affairs Senior Associate
item.description: Government Affairs Senior Associate Organization: Wounded Warrior Project® (WWP) Location: Washington, DC Date Posted: 08/12/2026 Great benefits. Competitive pay. We know these are some of the things people look for in a job. If you’re the kind of person who believes that honoring and empowering our nation’s veterans is more than just a cause — that it’s a calling — then we’re ready to meet you. When you join Wounded Warrior Project® (WWP), you’re committing to making a difference. We make a commitment to you, too – helping you to find that spark, ignite your passion to serve, and embark on a career with meaning and purpose. At WWP™, we recognize our mission cannot be accomplished without our talented teammates, which is why we’re proud to offer benefits such as: · A flexible hybrid work schedule (three days in the office, two days’ work from home) · Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for both teammates AND family members · Competitive pay and performance incentives · A fun, mission-focused, and collaborative team environment A mission that matters is just the beginning, so if you’re ready to get started, we’re ready for you. The Wounded Warrior Project (WWP) Government Affairs Senior Associate provides senior-level professional support to the Legislative Affairs team, assisting with the planning and implementation of WWP’s legislative and advocacy operations, to advance WWP’s mission and vision. The Government Affairs Senior Associate analyzes and reports on federal legislative and regulatory matters, develops and communicates WWP’s public policy positions, identifies new, timely opportunities to communicate the impact of WWP programs and services, and works to bolster relationships with legislative representatives, nonprofit organizations, and internal and external partners and stakeholders. DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Collaborate with the Government Affairs team to develop and execute federal advocacy initiatives based on WWP mission and priorities. Build and enhance strategic and collaborative relationships to advance WWP advocacy priorities and inform on WWP public policy positions. Establish networks and coalitions with external stakeholders and influencers, e.g., government, non-profit organizations, and others, to advance WWP public policy positions. Support Government Affairs Directors to develop and execute strong, well-designed advocacy campaigns for high-priority policy initiatives at the federal and state levels, and specifically tailored to the issue to maximize success. Attend hearings, meetings, and forums to network and provide advocacy for WWP priorities. Provide written analysis and recommendations to Government and Community Relations team. Represent WWP at key events, meetings, discussions, hearings, and conferences. Collaborate with the GCR Communications team to develop internal communications to raise awareness of Government Affairs team activities with all stakeholders. Coordinate engagements, working groups, roundtables, and meetings at the national and grassroots level. Assist with management of external resources and vendors who are supporting WWP advocacy efforts. Establish working relationships with WWP teammates to advance the mission and advocacy priorities and inform them about WWP public policy positions. Coordinate cross-organizational communication with WWP program management to support and inform on policy initiatives. Coordinate with Community Partnerships and Investments team, informing them on advocacy-related grants and projects. Analyze and report clearly and concisely on federal legislative and regulatory matters of interest to WWP. Develop community support for WWP. Present WWP vision and values to the community, effectively communicating WWP’s history, mission, and vision, and the benefits of WWP programs and services, and inspire them to become involved with and support WWP. Attend and actively participate in required training and/or meetings, including but not limited to New Teammate Orientation, WWP Cares, ASIST Suicide Prevention training, Leadership training, culture/team-based training, or departmental huddles. Other duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES Demonstrated ability to think strategically, analyze complex information, and recommend creative, practical, high-impact solutions. Demonstrated research capabilities. Demonstrated understanding of the legislative process. Demonstrated understanding of policy and advocacy issues and processes. Strong understanding of relationship management and partnering. Well-developed interpersonal skills to effectively interact with diverse individuals. Demonstrated relationship-building skills. Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive matters with diplomacy, empathy, and confidentiality, and build effective working relationships. Continuously enhance knowledge to better support the organization. Demonstrated broad and in-depth knowledge and understanding of military service organization (MSO) and veteran service organization (VSO) community needs, concerns, issues. Strong professional presence and demeanor. High energy level. Self-starter; willing to take initiative. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Microsoft Office, e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint. Good organizational and time management skills. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and meet deadlines. Unequivocal commitment to the highest standards of personal and business ethics and conduct. Mission-driven, guided by core values, and a pleasure to work with. EXPERIENCE Requirements Five years of experience in advocacy, policy, and/or legislative affairs or research. Preferences Three years of military experience or working with veteran’s or military service organizations. Three years of experience working with a non-profit organization. Two years of experience working in a Congressional office, an Executive branch office, or with a lobby firm. EDUCATION Requirements Bachelor’s degree in political science, business, management, communication, or other relevant field of study. Equivalent combination of education, experience, training, or certification may be considered in lieu of degree. Preferences Master’s degree or Juris Doctorate. CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSURE Requirements Ability to obtain ASIST Certification within 1 year of hire. Preferences ASIST Certification. WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS General office environment; temperature controlled Up to 25% travel We recognize the success of our mission depends on the efforts of our passionate, hard-working teammates. To help teammates remain focused on the warriors and families we serve, WWP offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Medical/Prescription drug, Dental, Vision, Life/AD&D, Short-term Disability, Long-term Disability, and an Employee Assistance Program. WWP also offers a 401(k)-retirement plan, a competitive PTO package, Sick Leave, Family Care Leave, Paid Holidays, Birthday Holiday, Education Assistance, Teammate Wellness Program, and Bereavement Leave. For Washington, D.C. Applicants: The estimated hiring range for this position is between $90,316 – $112,896 annual base salary, subject to a candidate’s combination of experience, qualifications, and credentials. This position may also be eligible for an annual performance incentive. *ca-ml #LI-HYBRID Wounded Warrior Project® is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all persons without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, age, veteran or military status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please note: Wounded Warrior Project is not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms without a written search agreement in place. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Wounded Warrior Project via email, the Internet or directly to hiring managers at Wounded Warrior Project in any form without a valid written search agreement in place will be deemed the sole property of Wounded Warrior Project, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Wounded Warrior Project as a result of the referral or through other means.
